description: List saved mission-test configs in your workspace with rich filters. Each saved config is a reusable mission-test definition (name, phone, sector, persona/mission, acceptance criterion, profile, optional tags). Filter by: `name` (substring), `phoneNumber` (E.164 exact), `sector` (e.g. `financial-services`), `profileId`, `tag` (lowercase exact, single tag), `createdAfter` / `createdBefore` (ISO8601). Sort by `createdAt` or `name`, asc/desc (default `createdAt desc`). Paginate via `cursor` + `limit` (1..100, default 50). Use when: the user wants to find or list configs by attribute ("configs for compliance-EU", "configs for phone +44…", "configs tagged X", "configs created this month"). Returns a slim projection — for full mission/acceptance text use getMissionTestConfig once you have identified the config. Configs can be edited (in the web app, or PATCH /testing/mission-test-configs/{id} on the REST API; no MCP tool saves an edit), and each row carries `updatedAt`, the time of its last edit. The date filters are on createdAt only: to find configs added in a time window, filter by createdAfter / createdBefore; to find recently edited ones, compare `updatedAt`. The `name` filter is case-sensitive: if a name search finds nothing, list without `name` and look through the names before telling the user a config does not exist. These are NOT standard (scripted) test configs: for those use listTestConfigs. Cross-tool: for the run history launched from a specific config, use listTestRuns?configId=X. For pass-rate-by-config, use aggregateTestRuns?groupBy=configId. Mission configs are workspace-scoped; cross-workspace returns 404.

createdAfter.description: ISO8601 date-time. Only configs created after it.

createdBefore.description: ISO8601 date-time. Only configs created before it.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from `nextCursor` in a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum configs to return per page (1-100, default 50). Use `cursor` for the next page.

name.description: Only configs whose name contains this text. Case-sensitive.

phoneNumber.description: Only configs that call this number. E.164, exact match, for example `+441234567890`.

profileId.description: Only configs that use this profile.

sector.description: Only configs in this sector, for example `financial-services`. Exact match.

sort.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to `createdAt`.

tag.description: Only configs carrying this tag. One tag, lowercase, exact match.

name: listMissionTestConfigs

outputSchema.description:
Response shape for GET /mission-test-configs (Phase 2 apiKey-gateway path).
The legacy /testing/mission-test-configs route on the Cognito gateway
keeps returning the full MissionTestConfig items for frontend back-compat
(no breaking change). `nextCursor` is absent when no more pages remain.

items.description:
Slim projection of MissionTestConfig for list responses. Drops `mission`
and `acceptance` long-text fields to keep payload small. Use
getMissionTestConfig to fetch the full row including mission/acceptance.

allOf.description:
Optional advanced turn-detection overrides for a single mission test.
Mirrors `api/packages/schemas/entities/missionAdvancedParams.ts` (Zod).
All-or-nothing: every field is required when this object is present —
this is what makes it safe for the values to be sent to Telnyx as a
single per-call block regardless of whether Telnyx merges into or
replaces the stored assistant's turn-detection settings. Omit the
object entirely to keep the server's env-var defaults.

eagerEotThreshold.description:
Lets the assistant start preparing a reply before it is sure the
other side has finished (0.3-0.9). It does not make the assistant
wait longer; `eotThreshold` does. Equal to `eotThreshold` switches
early preparation off.

eotThreshold.description:
The main control: how confident the assistant must be that the
other side has finished speaking before it replies (0.5-0.9). 0.9
waits longest and interrupts least; 0.5 replies at almost any pause.

eotTimeoutMs.description:
The longest the assistant sits through silence, in milliseconds,
before replying anyway. A ceiling, not a minimum wait: raising it
does not stop interruptions.

advancedParams.description:
Optional per-call turn-detection overrides. Absent means
mission-tester keeps its env-var defaults.

allOf.description:
Caller background noise: café chatter, city street traffic, home (children and a
baby crying) or wind buffeting. The level is fixed per sound.

backgroundNoise.description: Caller background noise played under the call. Omit for none.

allOf.description:
The language a mission test call is held in. These are the languages
Telnyx `deepgram/flux` accepts on the AI Assistant: one language, or
`multi` (Flux-multi), which code-switches across the other ten. Absent
means English. Mirrors `api/packages/schemas/entities/callLanguage.ts`
(Zod). Distinct from the transcription languages standard tests and
mapping use (`en-GB` etc.).

language.description: The call language. Absent means English.

maxDurationSecs.description:
Optional per-call duration cap in seconds. Omit to use the server
default for the mission kind (freeform 180s, compliance 90s).

voiceId.description:
Telnyx voice id for the call, from the operator-enabled catalogue
(`GET /testing/voices`). Omit to use the configured default voice.

nextCursor.description: Opaque base64 cursor for pagination. Absent when no more pages.

title: List Mission Test Configs
